name: Sudowrite
desc: AI writing partner built specifically for fiction and long manuscripts.
desc_zh: 专为小说与长篇写作打造的 AI 写作搭档。
solves: Covers plotting, prose rewriting and long-form structure without flattening your voice into generic assistant prose.
solves_zh: 从情节到长篇结构都能帮上，又不会把你的文风压成千篇一律的助手腔。
best_for: Reaching for it when you are writing a novel and generic chat assistants stall at the middle.
best_for_zh: 写长篇小说、普通聊天助手写到中段就卡住时。
notes: 外部发现渠道补录：aimojo.io editor's picks listing Sudowrite among top-rated writing tools。来源：https://every.to/chainletters/an-ai-might-have-written-this
